reasons.hexweaver: Strengths: the boss fight has a phased health bar, named attacks like Clapper Sweep and Great Toll, and red ground telegraphs. Loot uses light beams, rarity-coloured labels and item toasts, and there are plenty of floating crit numbers backed by heavy sound use. Weaknesses: the spells are mostly generic glowing orbs and particles, the enemies are simple low-poly props with little visible animation, the fights cluster into short bursts with long empty stretches (frames 7–9 and 12), and dense text overlaps and clutters the screen during combat.
reasons.pyromancer: The strongest parts are the HUD and loot: there's a boss bar with phase markers, phase and 'Vanquished' banners, a spell bar with cooldowns, a minimap, rarity-coloured loot beams and item toasts, and 537 sound voices with crit-tagged damage numbers. The weak parts are the visuals: spell effects are mostly flat low-poly confetti and white rings that clutter fights (frame 6 is an unreadable mess). Enemies are simple primitive-built models with little visible animation, and the only clear telegraph is one red ground lane in frame 12. The camera is third-person, not first-person, and many frames show no combat at all.
reasons.stormcaller: The strongest parts are the HUD and the loot. The HUD has a boss bar with phase markers, enrage and 'Vanquished' banners, and a cooldown spell bar. Loot gets rarity-coloured beams and item toasts, and crits show as yellow numbers. The weak parts are the low-poly enemies and environment, and some spell effects that just look like white blobs. Frames 8–11 are mostly empty walking with no combat, and only a few enemy attacks are clearly telegraphed, such as the red ground markers on the boss.
reasons.warden: Strengths: the boss has a named health bar with phase pips, an enrage tag and named attacks such as Clapper Sweep and Great Toll. There are red ground telegraphs, loot beams with rarity-coloured toasts and tooltips, plus a clean HUD with a cooldown spell bar and a minimap. Weaknesses: the enemies are simple primitive-built models and the town is flat blocky geometry. The spell effects lean on generic bubbles and glyph circles, and when they stack up close (frames 1 and 8) they bury the action. Hit feedback is mostly modest damage numbers, with only 3 crits and little visible flash or knockback.
